title: Muxed account with ID 16, and ID strings that parse to 16 without being "16"
description: A MuxedAccount (M… address) with the 64-bit ID 16. The ID has one canonical text form, the decimal string "16". An SDK that parses ID strings loosely accepts "0x10" or " 16 " for the same account and then reports the ID as typed, so two objects for one M… address disagree about its ID; an empty string silently becomes ID 0.

shapes.note: Core does not interpret the id field; it is passed through. To be confirmed against core source for the guide.

provenance.method: Encoded from XDR-JSON (the M… strkey) with the stellar-xdr CLI. The ed25519 key is the public key of the seed sha256("xdr-corpus issuer 0").
provenance.rationale: Hand-built because it is a bare MuxedAccount. Any transaction or payment may name a muxed account with any 64-bit ID since protocol 13 (CAP-0027).

operations.why: Control: the canonical ID string with the payload's base key gives the payload's bytes.
Hexadecimal is not a canonical ID.
Surrounding whitespace is not part of an ID.
An empty string is not ID 0.
A leading zero must be rejected or normalised; the object must not report "016" as its ID.

notes: Both verdicts were measured on 2026-11-17 with the published npm packages (repro/README.md).
